# The Python requirements of Apache Cassandra's cassandra-dtest at commit
# 7d8aaaace3115d06f1de263b6d038c1bacf8b721, for Python 3.11, each pinned to
# an exact version and its hashes. They are the packages of its
# requirements.txt with packaging<21 taken as 20.9, and setuptools for ccm.
# cassandra-dtest names the driver and ccm by git branch and tag, so the
# workflow installs those two from pinned commits with no dependencies,
# and their dependencies are listed here. The versions were resolved with
# pip-compile 7.4.1, and the hashes are those PyPI gives for every file of each version.
